sentences.zh: 吉姆急于带丹尼斯参观小镇，他们的第一站是与当地的一位教区神父会面。丹尼斯觉得这有点

sentences.en: unusual for a police tour of the town but being a devout catholic he wanted to check out the church to meet the priest anyway.
sentences.zh: 不寻常，不像是常规的警务城镇观光，但作为一个虔诚的天主教徒，他无论如何也想去教堂看看并见见神父。

sentences.en: Imagine his surprise when he was introduced to Father John Day.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，当他被介绍认识约翰·代神父时，他是多么惊讶。

sentences.en: Dennis recognised him instantly from the St Kilda incident six years earlier.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯立刻认出了他，就是六年前圣基尔达事件中的那个人。

sentences.en: Day had been transferred from the Apollo Bay Parish to the Mildura Parish the year after that incident in 1957.
sentences.zh: 在那起事件发生的一年后的1957年，代神父从阿波罗湾教区调到了米尔杜拉教区。

sentences.en: The meeting was friendly enough and Dennis didn't mention anything to Day.
sentences.zh: 会面还算友好，丹尼斯没有对代神父提起任何事。

sentences.en: Day didn't seem to recognise Dennis either, which was no surprise given how drunk he was when they met previously.
sentences.zh: 代神父似乎也没认出丹尼斯，考虑到他们上次见面时丹尼斯喝得那么醉，这倒也不足为奇。

sentences.en: As they were driving away from the meeting, Dennis said to Jim that Day had some unusual habits for a prieSt. He then filled him in about the incident from six years earlier.
sentences.zh: 当他们开车离开会面地点时，丹尼斯对吉姆说，代神父作为神父有一些不同寻常的习惯。接着他把六年前的那起事件告诉了吉姆。

sentences.en: Jim Barrett didn't have the reaction Dennis was expecting.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·巴雷特的反应并不是丹尼斯所预料的。

sentences.en: He snapped, yelling, you don't know what you're talking about get your facts right before you open your gob
sentences.zh: 他勃然大怒，大吼道，你根本不知道自己在说什么，开口闭口之前先把事实搞清楚

sentences.en: dennis didn't back dinner he had his facts right he had seen it with his own eyes
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯没有退缩，他掌握的事实确凿，那是他亲眼所见的

sentences.en: after a bit of back and forth the guided tour came to an early end jim drove dennis back to the station in silence there was a bit more back and forth between them
sentences.zh: 经过一番争执后，这次参观提前结束了，吉姆一路沉默着开车把丹尼斯送回了警局，他们之间还有更多的口角

sentences.en: in the office for the rest of the day clearly detective sergeant jim barrett was a staunch defender of the local prieSt. The next day Dennis received a phone call from Father Day
sentences.zh: 在办公室里持续了一整天，显然侦探中士吉姆·巴雷特是当地神父的坚定捍卫者。第二天，丹尼斯接到了代神父的电话

sentences.en: who requested that he pay him a visit.
sentences.zh: 要求他去拜访他一下。

sentences.en: Dennis agreed and drove over to meet with him.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯同意了，并开车去与他会面。

sentences.en: Day was angry.
sentences.zh: 代神父很生气。

sentences.en: He yelled, you need to get your facts straight, you don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 他大吼道，你需要把事实搞清楚，你根本不知道自己在说什么。

sentences.en: That wasn't me, there was another priest named John Day.
sentences.zh: 那个人不是我，还有另一个名叫约翰·代的神父。

sentences.en: He was also at Apollo Bay.
sentences.zh: 他也曾在阿波罗湾呆过。

sentences.en: I've never been to the place.
sentences.zh: 我从来没去过那个地方。

sentences.en: After a bit of back and forth between them Day said get out of my sight.
sentences.zh: 在他们之间的一番争执后，代神父说，从我眼前消失。

sentences.en: Don't you spread Melissa's rumours about me.
sentences.zh: 不要到处散布关于我的恶意谣言。

sentences.en: Get out.
sentences.zh: 滚开。

sentences.en: Dennis returned to the station and was met by another barrage of abuse from Jim Barrett.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯回到警局，迎面又遭到吉姆·巴雷特的一通恶语相加。

sentences.en: It was an interesting start to his time at Mildura.
sentences.zh: 这是他在米尔杜拉度过的一段有趣开端。

sentences.en: Dennis learnt very early that Barrett and Day were more than just friends.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯很早就发现，巴雷特和代神父不仅仅是普通朋友。

sentences.en: The way Jim had reacted and immediately jumped to the defensive day, there seemed to be something else going on, but he wasn't quite sure what.
sentences.zh: 吉姆的反应方式以及立即跳出来为代神父辩护，似乎背后还有其他隐情，但他并不是很确定是什么。

sentences.en: Dennis Rowan kept up his regular visits to the church with his family.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·罗温和家人继续保持着去教堂的常规拜访。

sentences.en: He sat back almost in amusement as he listened to Father Day talk about the church's strong position on virginity, celibacy and morality.
sentences.zh: 他几乎带着好笑的心情坐在后面，听着代神父谈论教堂关于贞洁、独身和道德的坚定立场。

sentences.en: He would drone on about the degrading and unchristian practice of girls wearing bikinis and the declining moral standards of society with girls getting around in miniskirts.
sentences.zh: 他会喋喋不休地抱怨女孩穿比基尼这种有失体面且有违基督教义的行为，还抱怨社会的道德标准在下降，女孩们居然穿着迷你裙到处晃悠。

sentences.en: All Dennis could see was a two-faced hypocrite if only his fellow churchgoers knew about that incident in St Kilda.
sentences.zh: 在丹尼斯眼中，迪恩纯粹是一个两面三刀的伪君子，要是他在教会的同僚们知道圣基尔达发生的那件事就好了。

sentences.en: The deep bond shared by Father Day and Detective Sergeant Jim Barrett only became clearer to Dennis as the years went on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，戴神父与探长吉姆·巴雷特之间深厚的纽带在丹尼斯看来变得愈发清晰。

sentences.en: Dennis formed the view that Barrett was a right-hand man today
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯逐渐觉得巴雷特如今成了对方的左膀右臂。

sentences.en: The two of them also shared a close relationship with another man, Joe Kearney
sentences.zh: 这两人与另一个人也有着密切的关系，那就是乔·卡尼。

sentences.en: Kearney was the clerk of a local court in Mildura
sentences.zh: 卡尼是米尔迪拉当地法院的书记员。

sentences.en: No big deal in a major city like Melbourne But in a small country town like Mildura, he had much more authority
sentences.zh: 在墨尔本这样的大城市这或许不算什么，但在米尔迪拉这样的小乡镇，他拥有大得多的权威。

sentences.en: There was no permanent judge in town
sentences.zh: 镇上没有常驻法官。

sentences.en: The judge worked a large district, what was called a circuit Which covered a large area and a lot of different towns
sentences.zh: 这位法官负责一个很大的辖区，也就是所谓的巡回区，涵盖了广阔的地域和许多不同的城镇。

sentences.en: The judge would travel around and sit at the different courts as he was required.
sentences.zh: 法官会四处奔波，根据需要到各个法庭开庭。

sentences.en: When there was no judge in town, which was most of the time,
sentences.zh: 当镇上没有法官时（这种情况占了大多数时间），

sentences.en: Joe Kearney was the most senior official of the court.
sentences.zh: 乔·卡尼就是法院级别最高的官员。

sentences.en: Day, Barrett and Kearney were extremely close, regularly meeting up to have dinner, always having meetings together.
sentences.zh: 戴、巴雷特和卡尼关系极为亲密，经常聚在一起吃晚饭，总是一起开会。

sentences.en: As well as his role of clerk of the court,
sentences.zh: 除了担任法院书记员的职务外，

sentences.en: Kearney was also treasurer of the Mildura Catholic Parish Funds, meaning he was in charge of funds paid by the government for the admin and maintenance of
sentences.zh: 卡尼同时还是米尔迪拉天主教教区基金会的财务主管，这意味着他负责掌管政府拨付的资金，用于支付和维护

sentences.en: Catholic schools in the parish.
sentences.zh: 教区内的天主教学校。

sentences.en: In Mildura the Catholic schools were Sacred Heart Primary and St Joseph's High.
sentences.zh: 在米尔迪拉，天主教学校有圣心小学和圣若瑟高中。

sentences.en: So Kearney was in charge of a lot of money that had to cover teachers salaries building maintenance curriculum expenses and everything else required to run a school.
sentences.zh: 因此，卡尼掌管着大量资金，这些资金必须支付教师薪水、建筑维护、课程费用以及运营学校所需的一切开销。

sentences.en: Barrett was in charge of the collection plate on behalf of Father Day.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特代表戴神父负责收集奉献盘里的捐款。

sentences.en: He used to like standing over the parishioners demanding more money.
sentences.zh: 他很喜欢站在 parishioners（教区居民）面前逼他们交出更多的钱。

sentences.en: Day needed it.
sentences.zh: 戴神父需要钱。

sentences.en: The church needed it.
sentences.zh: 教会需要钱。

sentences.en: Give more.
sentences.zh: 多捐点。

sentences.en: Dennis couldn't work out why Day was constantly crying poor and demanding more money from his people.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯百思不得其解，为什么戴神父总是哭穷，并不断向信众索要更多钱财。

sentences.en: He always drove a new, expensive-looking car.
sentences.zh: 他开的总是崭新、看起来很贵气车。

sentences.en: He had a taste for fine wines and flash clothes.
sentences.zh: 他品味高雅，喜欢好酒和华丽的衣服。

sentences.en: The church was always immaculately decorated.
sentences.zh: 教堂总是装饰得一尘不染。

sentences.en: He didn't seem to be doing too badly.
sentences.zh: 他看起来过得相当不错。

sentences.en: It was all very suspicious to Dennis, but he just stayed out of it.
sentences.zh: 这一切在丹尼斯看来都非常可疑，但他选择置身事外。

sentences.en: He didn't want anything to do with Day, Barrett or Kearney.
sentences.zh: 他不想和戴、巴雷特或卡尼有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: He wasn't going to let them affect his faith.
sentences.zh: 他绝不让这些人动摇自己的信仰。

sentences.en: Dennis never rated Barrett as a detective.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯从来不觉得巴雷特算什么合格的侦探。

sentences.en: All he liked to do was pick on kids and arrest drunks.
sentences.zh: 他唯一喜欢做的事就是欺负小孩、逮捕酒鬼。

sentences.en: Serious crime was out of his depth.
sentences.zh: 重大犯罪根本超出了他的能力范围。

sentences.en: Dennis was especially disgusted when he learnt that Father Day would let Barrett know about the secrets shared to him in the confessional box.
sentences.zh: 当丹尼斯得知戴神父会把告解室里听到的秘密透露给巴雷特时，他感到格外恶心。

sentences.en: School kids would come in and confess to Mish if they got up to, maybe stealing a candy bar from the local store or breaking into the canteen and stealing soft drinks.
sentences.zh: 学校的孩子们如果犯了点事，比如从当地商店偷了一根糖果棒，或者闯入小卖部偷汽水，就会来向米什告解。

sentences.en: Next thing the kids knew, Jim Barrett was knocking on their door and dragging them into the police station for an interview.
sentences.zh: 孩子们还没回过神来，吉姆·巴雷特就已经敲响了他们的家门，把他们拖进警察局接受盘问。

sentences.en: Day completely breached the kids' truSt. It disgusted Dennis and he hated Barrett.
sentences.zh: 戴神父彻底背叛了孩子们的信任。这让丹尼斯感到作呕，他恨透了巴雷特。

sentences.en: hated his aggressive controlling behaviour and his deep connection today.
sentences.zh: 他痛恨巴雷特那种咄咄逼人的控制欲，以及他和戴神父之间深厚的勾连。

sentences.en: He sensed something wasn't right, and he decided to start digging.
sentences.zh: 他直觉有哪里不对劲，于是决定开始深入调查。

sentences.en: Barrett was very secretive of the contents of his drawer.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特对抽屉里的东西守口如瓶。

sentences.en: He had his own office which he would often keep locked, but if his office wasn't locked, then one thing was for sure.
sentences.zh: 他有自己的办公室，而且经常锁着门；但如果他的办公室没锁，那有一件事是肯定的。

sentences.en: The top drawer of his desk would be.
sentences.zh: 他办公桌的最上面那个抽屉一定是锁着的。

sentences.en: Barrett kept the key lock his life depended on it.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特把钥匙看得比自己的命还重要。

sentences.en: Dennis and another detective often wondered what Barrett was keeping in there one day they found out they were able to break into the drawer by getting a second key cut
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯和另一名侦探常常好奇巴雷特在里面藏了些什么，有一天他们发现通过根据锁上的唯一代码配一把备用钥匙，就能撬开那个抽屉。

sentences.en: using a unique code found on the lock as they opened it they were met by some insignificant paperwork but it was underneath that where they found five black and white photographs
sentences.zh: 当他们打开抽屉时，映入眼帘的是一些无关紧要的文件，但就在这些文件底下，他们找到了五张黑白照片。

sentences.en: the photos were of girls aged about eight to ten years old all standing naked with glum expressions on their faces.
sentences.zh: 照片上是大约八到十岁的小女孩，她们都赤身裸体，脸上带着郁闷的表情。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案件档案稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持案件档案栏目继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: Dennis initially thought that these might be evidence from a case, but the more he thought about it, the more that didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯最初以为这些可能是某个案件的证据，但转念一想，又觉得完全说不通。

sentences.en: If the photos were evidence, they would have been entered into the evidence book and stored in the property room.
sentences.zh: 如果这些照片是证据，它们本该登记在证据册里并存放在物证室中。

sentences.en: They quickly put the photos back and locked the drawer.
sentences.zh: 他们迅速把照片放回原处并锁好抽屉。

sentences.en: Dennis knew Jim Barrett was odd and was very close to Father Day, but what was he doing with these photos?
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯知道吉姆·巴雷特这人很古怪，而且和戴神父关系极其密切，但他留着这些照片到底想干什么？

sentences.en: He kept the information close.
sentences.zh: 他把这些情报捂得很紧。

sentences.en: He couldn't do anything about it for now.
sentences.zh: 眼下他什么也做不了。

sentences.en: He had illegally broken into Barrett's drawer.
sentences.zh: 他毕竟是非法私闯并撬开了巴雷特的抽屉。

sentences.en: Not only that, Barrett could easily make up some bullshit about them being linked to a case, even if they weren't.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，哪怕这些照片跟案件毫无关系，巴雷特也能轻易编出一堆屁话，说它们与某个案子有关。

sentences.en: Barrett could have backdated an entry in the evidence book and say they weren't stored in the property room due to their sensitive nature.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特完全可以伪造证据册里的条目日期，辩称由于照片性质敏感才没有存放在物证室里。

sentences.en: All it would achieve would be to get Dennis into some serious trouble.
sentences.zh: 这么做唯一的结果就是让丹尼斯惹上大麻烦。

sentences.en: Dennis decided to wait and dig a little further.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯决定按兵不动，再进一步挖掘。

sentences.en: He knew something else about Barrett.
sentences.zh: 他深知巴雷特身上还有别的猫腻。

sentences.en: He always took carriage of sex offence cases involving young girls.
sentences.zh: 对方总是亲自负责涉及年轻女孩的性犯罪案件。

sentences.en: All the uniform officers and fellow detectives knew that any case such as that went straight to Barrett.
sentences.zh: 所有制服警员和其他侦探都知道，任何此类案件都会直接转交给巴雷特。

sentences.en: He always interviewed the girls alone with his office door locked.
sentences.zh: 他总是把办公室门反锁，单独盘问女孩们。

sentences.en: Still, it wasn't enough to prove anything.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这些证据还不足以证明任何事。

sentences.en: Dennis may have had a clearer picture if he had been made aware of the complaint made to Sergeant Michael
sentences.zh: 要是早知道迈克尔·奥唐纳警长曾接到过报案，

sentences.en: O'Donnell.
sentences.zh: 奥唐纳，

sentences.en: O'Donnell was a patrol officer who had transferred to Mildura not long after Dennis.
sentences.zh: 奥唐纳是一名巡警，在丹尼斯之后不久调职到了米尔迪拉。

sentences.en: O'Donnell received a complaint from a parent one afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一天下午，奥唐纳接到了一位家长的报案。

sentences.en: A young boy, still at Sacred Heart primary school had come home and told his dad that father Day had pinned him down and fondled his penis.
sentences.zh: 一个还在圣心小学上学的小男孩回家后告诉父亲，戴神父把他按倒在地并猥亵了他的下体。

sentences.en: O'Donnell took the complaint straight to the detectives.
sentences.zh: 奥唐纳拿着报案记录直接去找了侦探。

sentences.en: Dennis wasn't in his office so he didn't hear about it.
sentences.zh: 当时丹尼斯不在办公室，所以没有听到这事。

sentences.en: Another detective told O'Donnell that this wasn't the first complaint that had been made about Day but they couldn't do anything with it.
sentences.zh: 另一名侦探告诉奥唐纳，这并非针对戴神父的第一起投诉，但他们对此无能为力。

sentences.en: All complaints involving Day had to go to Detective Sergeant Jim Barrett.
sentences.zh: 所有涉及戴神父的投诉都必须交由侦探中士吉姆·巴雷特处理。

sentences.en: No exceptions.
sentences.zh: 绝无例外。

sentences.en: O'Donnell didn't see a problem with that.
sentences.zh: 奥唐纳当时并没有觉得这有什么问题。

sentences.en: It made sense.
sentences.zh: 这听起来合情合理。

sentences.en: Barrett was the head detective and this was a serious complaint.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特是首席侦探，而这是一起严重的报案。

sentences.en: O'Donnell forwarded the information onto Barrett for follow-up.
sentences.zh: 奥唐纳将信息转交给巴雷特以便跟进。

sentences.en: A week or so later, O'Donnell hadn't heard anything from Barrett about what was happening and Barrett wasn't the most friendly or approachable person.
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，奥唐纳没有从巴雷特那里听到任何进展，而且巴雷特本就不是那种既友善又容易接近的人。

sentences.en: So O'Donnell decided to pay the boy and his dad a visit to see what was happening.
sentences.zh: 于是奥唐纳决定去拜访那个男孩和他的父亲，看看究竟是怎么回事。

sentences.en: O'Donnell was told by the boy's dad that there was nothing happening.
sentences.zh: 男孩的父亲告诉奥唐纳，事情不了了之了。

sentences.en: Jim Barrett had paid them a visit and talked them into withdrawing the complaint.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·巴雷特登门拜访并说服他们撤回了报案。

sentences.en: Barrett described the scandal and shame that would come to their family if they went ahead with it.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特向他们描述了如果坚持起诉会给家族带来的丑闻与耻辱。

sentences.en: The boy had made a serious allegation against a good man and a fine priest and to the Catholic Church would not take such a complaint lying down.
sentences.zh: 男孩对一个好人和优秀的牧师做出了严重的虚假指控，天主教会绝不会对这种投诉善罢甘干休。

sentences.en: The dad explained to O'Donnell that he felt he had no choice but to withdraw, as Barrett didn't believe them.

sentences.en: He never had to face court.
sentences.zh: 他从未面临法庭审判。

sentences.en: His victims never got justice.
sentences.zh: 他的受害者从未得到正义。

sentences.en: Instead, what happened?
sentences.zh: 相反，发生了什么呢？

sentences.en: The church paid an all-expenses overseas trip to Day for counselling and spiritual healing.
sentences.zh: 教会资助了戴伊一次费用全包的海外心理辅导与精神疗愈之旅。

sentences.en: Barrett found himself in trouble too.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特也陷入了麻烦。

sentences.en: Not only was he protecting Day, but he was also acting as a standover man for him.
sentences.zh: 他不仅在包庇戴伊，还充当了戴伊的爪牙。

sentences.en: He went under investigation for extorting money from two men he had arrested.
sentences.zh: 他因敲诈勒索自己逮捕过的两名男子而接受调查。

sentences.en: Barrett told the men the charges would go away if they donated an appropriate amount of money into Father Day's building fund.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特告诉这两人，只要向戴伊神父的建堂基金捐赠一笔适当的金额，指控就会一笔勾销。

sentences.en: The building fund was for Day to build himself a brand new church and residence.
sentences.zh: 建堂基金是供戴伊为自己修建一座崭新的教堂和住所的。

sentences.en: It was well known around town by some of the criminal element that Barrett could help you beat a charge.
sentences.zh: 当地的一些犯罪分子很清楚，只要给戴伊神父

sentences.en: for a suitable donation to Father Day.
sentences.zh: 进行适当的捐款，巴雷特就能帮你摆脱罪名。

sentences.en: Not only that, Barrett stood over the illegal bookmakers in town on behalf of Day.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，巴雷特还代表戴伊威慑镇上的非法庄家。

sentences.en: What he would do is approach a bookie and say, Father Day will have
sentences.zh: 他的做法是找到一个庄家说，戴伊神父

sentences.en: $10 on the winner of the last race.
sentences.zh: 要在最后一场比赛的胜出者身上下注10美元。

sentences.en: The bookie knew exactly what that meant, and it had nothing to do with gambling.
sentences.zh: 庄家完全明白这意味着什么，这和赌博毫无关系。

sentences.en: Whichever horse won the last race, Day would win whatever it paid times 10.
sentences.zh: 无论哪匹马赢得最后一场比赛，戴伊赢得的金额将是其赔率乘以10。

sentences.en: and was the cost of doing business for the illegal bookmakers in Mildura.
sentences.zh: 而这就是米尔杜拉非法庄家开展业务的代价。

sentences.en: Not only was Day a pedophile, he was running an extortion racket with the help of a detective sergeant.
sentences.zh: 戴伊不仅是个恋童癖，还在一名警长的协助下经营着敲诈勒索集团。

sentences.en: And that wasn't the only racket they had going on.
sentences.zh: 而这还不是他们唯一的勾当。

sentences.en: There was the fraud arranged by
sentences.zh: 还有由

sentences.en: Joe Kearney, the local court clerk, who was also a part of this tight-knit group.
sentences.zh: 当地法院书记员乔·卡尼策划的欺诈勾当，他也是这个核心小圈子的一员。

sentences.en: He was the treasurer of the church's funds and in charge of the money given by the government to run the two
sentences.zh: 他是教会资金的财务主管，负责管理政府下拨用于运营两所

sentences.en: Catholic schools.
sentences.zh: 天主教学校的资金。

sentences.en: Well Joe had set up a nice little scam with that money.
sentences.zh: 乔利用这笔资金设下了一个精巧的小骗局。

sentences.en: He created a teacher's position that didn't exist and he hired a teacher that didn't exist to fill that position.
sentences.zh: 他虚构了一个根本不存在的教师职位，并雇用了根本不存在的老师来填补这个职位。

sentences.en: The government paid that teacher's salary which actually went straight into the pocket of Kearney who then passed it on to Father Day.
sentences.zh: 政府支付了该教师的薪水，而这笔钱实际上直接落入了卡尼的口袋，随后他又转交给戴伊神父。

sentences.en: On top of the scams was the constant badgering of the parishioners to donate money to the church.
sentences.zh: 除了种种骗局，还有对教区居民不断的纠缠，逼他们向教会捐款。

sentences.en: Day was relentless with those requests and Barrett was there holding the bag for him, making sure it was full.
sentences.zh: 戴伊的这些索取没完没了，巴雷特则在一旁为他保驾护航，确保钱袋装得满满当当。

sentences.en: O'Connor had gotten rid of Day nice and quietly, but now he had to get rid of Barrett.
sentences.zh: 奥康纳已经悄无声息地除掉了戴伊，但现在他必须除掉巴雷特。

sentences.en: He couldn't risk keeping him around Mildura after what happened.
sentences.zh: 经历了这些事后，他冒不起险把巴雷特留在米尔杜拉。

sentences.en: He was transferred to another station hundreds of kilometres away, out of sight, out of mind.
sentences.zh: 他被调到了几百公里外的另一个车站，眼不见心不烦。

sentences.en: The third member of their group, Joe Kearney, had to go as well.
sentences.zh: 他们团伙的第三名成员乔·卡尼也得走人。

sentences.en: An audit had just been conducted on the local court accounts.
sentences.zh: 当地法院的账目刚刚接受了审计。

sentences.en: There was money missing everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都有资金亏空。

sentences.en: Kearney wasn't just scamming the school funds, but he knew too much about Day and Barrett.
sentences.zh: 卡尼不仅在诈骗学校资金，而且他对戴伊和巴雷特的事情知道得太多了。

sentences.en: He was told if he left town and kept his mouth shut, he would be spared jail.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉他，只要离开小镇并守口如瓶，就能免于牢狱之灾。

sentences.en: He didn't have to be asked twice.
sentences.zh: 他不用别人催促第二次。

sentences.en: Kearney was also suspected of raping a woman in the courthouse, but she was too frightened to provide a statement against him, so he was never charged.
sentences.zh: 卡尼还涉嫌在法院强奸了一名女子，但由于她太害怕而不敢提供针对他的证词，因此他从未被起诉。

sentences.en: Dennis Ryan was still a loose end as well.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·瑞安也是一个尚未解决的麻烦。

sentences.en: O'Connor sat him down and told him he was going to be charged for failing to complete the outcome of an arrest in his diary.
sentences.zh: 奥康纳把他叫来，告诉他将因未能在工作日志中完整记录逮捕行动的最终结果而受到指控。

sentences.en: This wasn't a criminal charge, it was internal disciplinary action.
sentences.zh: 这不是刑事指控，而是内部纪律处分。

sentences.en: They couldn't get anything serious on Dennis, so they found this.
sentences.zh: 他们抓不到丹尼斯的什么重大把柄，所以找到了这个。

sentences.en: A trivial matter, which most of the detectives in the state probably could have been charged with if they looked close enough.
sentences.zh: 这是一件鸡毛蒜皮的小事，如果仔细搜查，州里的绝大多数侦探大概都能被扣上这样的罪名。

sentences.en: They were clutching at straws, basically.
sentences.zh: 说白了，他们这是在黔驴技穷。

sentences.en: Dennis didn't play ball, so this was his reward.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯不肯同流合污，这就是给他的回报。

sentences.en: O'Connor forwarded a final report to the Commissioner.
sentences.zh: 奥康纳向警察总监提交了一份最终报告。

sentences.en: In it, he said that the evidence was insufficient to prosecute Father the day.
sentences.zh: 其中提到，证据不足以起诉戴伊神父。

sentences.en: The priest was officially in the clear.
sentences.zh: 这位神父正式洗脱了嫌疑。

sentences.en: The investigation was stopped at some of the highest levels of the Victorian police.
sentences.zh: 调查在维多利亚州警察最高层的干预下被迫中止。

sentences.en: Nothing came with the investigation into Barrett extorting money.
sentences.zh: 关于巴雷特敲诈勒索钱财的调查也不了了之。

sentences.en: He kept his rank and position within the Victorian police.
sentences.zh: 他在维多利亚州警察局保留了军衔和职务。

sentences.en: He remained a detective sergeant for another eight years before retiring.
sentences.zh: 他又当了八年警长才退休。

sentences.en: He died in 1997.
sentences.zh: 他于1997年去世。

sentences.en: If Dennis Ryan was allowed to stay in
sentences.zh: 如果允许丹尼斯·瑞安留在

sentences.en: Mildura he would have kept taking statements and investigating Day.
sentences.zh: 米尔杜拉，他就会继续收集供词并调查戴伊。

sentences.en: That's what he planned to do and his superiors knew it.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的计划，他的上司们心知肚明。

sentences.en: They wouldn't allow it.
sentences.zh: 他们绝不允许这种情况发生。

sentences.en: His transfer order came through almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 他的调职令几乎立刻就下达了。

sentences.en: Dennis was told that he could apply for any station in the state of Victoria that was available
sentences.zh: 有人告诉丹尼斯，他可以申请维多利亚州内任何有空缺的警局

sentences.en: but if he wasn't successful finding anywhere by the 15th of May 1972 then he had to report to Russell Street back in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 但如果在1972年5月15日之前还没有找到任何地方，他就必须回墨尔本向罗素街报到。

sentences.en: His reward for investigating a pedophile priest and trying to get justice for the victims was a forced transfer.
sentences.zh: 他调查恋童癖神父并试图为受害者伸张正义的代价，竟然是一次强制调职。

sentences.en: Dennis went off on sick leave and then offered his resignation.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯请了病假，随后递交了辞呈。

sentences.en: He felt that if he left Mildura then the cover-up would be complete but if he stayed in Mildura then his voice could still be heard.
sentences.zh: 他觉得如果自己离开米尔杜拉，掩盖真相的行为就彻底得逞了，但如果留在米尔杜拉，他的声音就依然能被听到。

sentences.en: He could keep the trust of the victiMs. Although he would no longer be a police officer and couldn't conduct the investigation, he felt it was the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 他可以继续维持受害者的信任。尽管他不再是一名警官，也无法再进行调查，但他觉得这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: The Crown prosecutors completed a review of the case and confirmed the decisions of the senior police.
sentences.zh: 皇家检察官完成了对该案的审查，并确认了高级警官们的决定。

sentences.en: They said in their report,
sentences.zh: 他们在报告中写道：

sentences.en: There is insufficient evidence to prosecute Day.
sentences.zh: 没有足够证据起诉戴伊。

sentences.en: We trust the authorities in the church will realise that the decision not to prosecute does not arise from any conviction that the allegations are unfounded.
sentences.zh: 我们相信教会当局会明白，决定不起诉并不意味着确信这些指控毫无根据。

sentences.en: Having regard to the similarities of the various accounts, there would appear to be little doubt that Day misconducted himself.
sentences.zh: 鉴于各方陈述的相似性，几乎毫无疑问，戴伊确实有不当行径。

sentences.en: When Day returned from his all-expenses-paid overseas counselling trip, Bishop Mulcairn sent him to a tiny parish called Timboon, in country Victoria.
sentences.zh: 当戴伊结束了那趟费用全包的海外心理辅导之旅归来时，马尔肯斯主教把他派到了维多利亚州乡下一个名为廷布恩的小教区。

sentences.en: He was not prevented from being in contact with children, and the people of the town had no idea about Day's paSt. He stayed in the town until his death in 1978.
sentences.zh: 他并没有被禁止与儿童接触，镇上的人对戴伊的过去一无所知。他在该镇一直呆到1978年去世。

sentences.en: He was 74 years old.
sentences.zh: 享年74岁。

sentences.en: He had been a priest for 48 years.
sentences.zh: 他当了48年神父。

sentences.en: At Day's funeral, Bishop Mulcairns talked about his great work and his humble magnificence.
sentences.zh: 在戴伊的葬礼上，马尔肯斯主教赞扬了他的伟大功绩和谦逊崇高。

sentences.en: Quote, Lord, hear the prayers we offer for John Day, your servant and prieSt. He faithfully fulfilled his ministry in your name.
sentences.zh: 引述原话，主啊，请垂听我们为你的仆人兼神父约翰·戴伊献上的祈祷。他在你的名下忠实地履行了圣职。

sentences.en: May he rejoice forever in the fellowship of the saints.
sentences.zh: 愿他在众圣徒的团契中永远欢欣鼓舞。

sentences.en: Many of Day's victims descended into alcoholism, drug abuse, and some committed suicide.
sentences.zh: 戴伊的许多受害者最终陷入了酗酒和吸毒的泥潭，还有一些人选择了自杀。

sentences.en: Dennis remained in Mildura.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯留在了米尔杜拉。

sentences.en: His wife left him a few years after he left the police force.
sentences.zh: 在他离开警队几年后，他的妻子也离开了他。

sentences.en: He didn't stay quiet about Day or the cover-up by the church and members of the police force, but his pleas were ignored for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 对于戴伊以及教会和警方高层的掩盖行为，他一直没有闭口不言，但他的呼吁在很多很多年里都被无视了。

sentences.en: The official file said that Dennis had resigned from the police due to a personal conflict with Jim Barrett.
sentences.zh: 官方档案上说，丹尼斯是因为与吉姆·巴雷特的个人矛盾而辞去警察职务的。

sentences.en: and that there was insufficient evidence to prosecute Day.
sentences.zh: 并且没有足够证据起诉戴伊。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样过去了。

sentences.en: As the years went on and senior officers turned over, when any of them looked at the file, that's what they saw.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月流逝，高级警官更迭，每当有人翻看这份档案，看到的便是这些。

sentences.en: Things are obviously a lot different today.
sentences.zh: 如今的情况显然大不相同了。

sentences.en: In 1972, no priest had ever stood before a judge charged with a child sex offence.
sentences.zh: 在1972年，从未有神父因涉嫌儿童性犯罪而站上法官面前。

sentences.en: It was unheard of then.
sentences.zh: 这在当时是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: Priests could do no wrong.
sentences.zh: 神父是不会犯错的。

sentences.en: They held positions of trust in the community and were held in high regard
sentences.zh: 他们在社区中占据着受信任的地位，备受尊敬

sentences.en: Spiritual guardians
sentences.zh: 精神守护者

sentences.en: Today, it's not unheard of for a priest to be charged with a child sex offence
sentences.zh: 如今，神父因涉嫌儿童性犯罪被起诉已非新鲜事

sentences.en: It's acknowledged now that there was a serious problem with some priests And a lot of crimes have been covered up over the years
sentences.zh: 人们现在已经承认，一些神父存在严重的问题，而且多年来许多罪行都被掩盖了

sentences.en: The Catholic Church set up a compensation fund in Australia called Towards Healing
sentences.zh: 天主教会曾在澳大利亚设立了一个名为“走向治愈”的赔偿基金

sentences.en: Giving money to victims of abuse but to get the money the victims have to sign a non-disclosure agreement.
sentences.zh: 向虐待受害者提供金钱赔偿，但为了拿到这笔钱，受害者必须签署保密协议。

sentences.en: In 2006, Dennis Ryan was told that over 100 people had come forward to claim compensation as a direct result of sexual and indecent assaults committed by Father Day.
sentences.zh: 2006年，丹尼斯·瑞安得知已有100多人站出来索赔，起因正是戴伊神父犯下的性侵和猥亵罪行。

sentences.en: And they weren't just from Mildura.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不仅仅来自米尔杜拉。

sentences.en: Day had committed his horrific acts at his other parishes as well.
sentences.zh: 戴伊在其他教区也犯下了骇人听闻的罪行。

sentences.en: They were also covered up.
sentences.zh: 这些罪行同样被掩盖了。

sentences.en: When the rumours got too loud and complaints started to be made against him, the bishop simply moved him on to another parish.
sentences.zh: 每当流言四起、针对他的投诉开始出现时，主教就会轻描淡写地把他调到另一个教区。

sentences.en: Day was given a fresh start in a new town to ruin the lives of more victiMs. The Catholic mafia element of the Victorian police
sentences.zh: 戴伊在一个新的小镇获得了重新开始的机会，去毁掉更多受害者的生活。维多利亚州警察部队中

sentences.en: force that existed between the 1950s and 1970s is long gone.
sentences.zh: 存在于20世纪50年代至70年代的天主教黑帮势力早已不复存在。

sentences.en: Religion itself is nowhere near as prominent in society and in turn the police force as it was back then.
sentences.zh: 宗教在如今的社会乃至警界，其影响力已远不及当年。

sentences.en: Times have changed.
sentences.zh: 时代变了。

sentences.en: In 2012, Dennis Ryan published a book called Unholy Trinity, which gives his account of this story.
sentences.zh: 2012年，丹尼斯·赖安出版了一本名为《邪恶三位一体》的书，记录了他对这段故事的讲述。

sentences.en: That book was read at some of the highest levels of the Victorian government and police force.
sentences.zh: 这本书甚至传到了维多利亚州政府和警界的最高层。

sentences.en: It was also used in the Royal Commission into Institutional Responses to Child sex abuse.
sentences.zh: 它还被提交给调查机构性虐待儿童事件的皇家委员会使用。

sentences.en: This Royal Commission is still taking place today, covering different reports of abuse from all over the country.
sentences.zh: 该皇家委员会至今仍在运作，负责处理来自全国各地关于虐待行为的不同报告。

sentences.en: A lot of different cases and offenders and responses to those cases are still being looked at.
sentences.zh: 许多不同的案件、罪犯以及对这些案件的处理结果仍在接受审查。

sentences.en: One case the Royal Commission dealt with was that of Father Day.
sentences.zh: 皇家委员会处理的其中一个案件便是戴伊神父案。

sentences.en: In 2015, the Royal Commission heard about the sexual and indecent assaults committed by Father
sentences.zh: 2015年，皇家委员会听取了关于戴伊神父犯下的性侵和猥亵罪行，

sentences.en: Day and the cover-up of Dennis Ryan's work by other officers.
sentences.zh: 以及其他警官对丹尼斯·赖安的工作进行掩盖的陈述。

sentences.en: Former Victorian Police Commissioner
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州前警察局长

sentences.en: Mick Miller had this to say to the commission, quote, without doubt there was misconduct by senior
sentences.zh: 米克·米勒向委员会作出了如下陈述，引述如下：毫无疑问，维多利亚州的高级警官存在违纪行为，

sentences.en: Victorian police officers, including dereliction of duty, conspiracy to pervert the course of
sentences.zh: 包括渎职、串谋妨碍司法公正，

sentences.en: justice, and inciting other members of the police force to join the conspiracy against Dennis Ryan in order to conceal crimes committed by Day.
sentences.zh: 以及煽动警队其他成员加入针对丹尼斯·赖安的阴谋，以掩盖戴伊犯下的罪行。

sentences.en: Dennis himself gave evidence of the commission.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯本人在委员会上作了证。

sentences.en: His story was finally taken as fact.
sentences.zh: 他的故事终于被当作事实采纳。

sentences.en: No longer was he being ignored.
sentences.zh: 他不再被冷落和忽视。

sentences.en: It was accepted there was a cover-up of Day's crimes by some bishops and by some police officers.
sentences.zh: 各方终于承认，某些主教和警官确实对戴伊的罪行进行了掩盖。

sentences.en: It was accepted that a group of police existed that put a halt to any investigation into a prieSt. The group was known as the Catholic Mafia.
sentences.zh: 各方承认，曾存在一个警员集团，阻挠对任何神职人员的调查。这个集团被称为“天主教黑手党”。

sentences.en: A lot of the members would remain unknown, but they certainly wielded their influence in Mildura in the early 70s.
sentences.zh: 许多成员的身份至今不明，但他们在70年代初的米尔杜拉确实极具影响力。

sentences.en: The rumour erupted in applause when Dennis stepped down from the witness box after giving his evidence.
sentences.zh: 当丹尼斯作完证走下证人席时，现场爆发出一片掌声。

sentences.en: It was only last month, August 2016, that Dennis got his final vindication.
sentences.zh: 就在上个月，即2016年8月，丹尼斯终于得到了彻底的平反。

sentences.en: Current Victorian Police Commissioner Graham Ashton invited Dennis to a morning tea.
sentences.zh: 现任维多利亚州警察局长格雷厄姆·阿什顿邀请丹尼斯参加了一场茶话会。
